title: The PewDiePipeline: how racist humor leads to violence
summary: NonCompete's video examines the alt-right pipeline and a 'pyramid of violence' running from implicit bias through edgy racist humor to real violence. It uses the PewDiePie controversy and Charlottesville as case studies.
why: Pointed to in radicalization threads as a good explanation of how online humor can funnel people toward extremism.

quote.text: A good video which goes over this is The PewDiePieline
